channel.title: Biagio Cyberspace
channel.description: Biagio Scaglia's personal blog: full-stack developer, UX/UI designer, and lover of the retro web.

item.title: Major Site Upgrade: Web Audio Synth Engine, Instant Search & Kaomoji Magic! (⁠★⁠u⁠★⁠)
item.description: A huge new site update is live! Added a Web Audio API synth sound engine, Win95 SFX toggle, top reading progress bar, instant search, and code copy buttons! (⁠ﾉ⁠◕⁠ヮ⁠◕⁠)⁠ﾉ⁠*⁠・ﾟ✧

item.title: Reconnecting Offline: Lecce, Archery, and a 2km Sea Crossing (^_−)☆
item.description: A personal reflection on stepping away from the IDE to travel across Puglia—visiting friends in Lecce and Foggia, discovering an unexpected skill in archery, and swimming 2km to a small island.

item.title: The Urge to Build: Moon Inferno's Spark and Impostor Shadows (ー_ー〃)
item.description: A personal reflection on the unexpected success of Moon-Inferno, having too many ideas, missing coding during vacation, and dealing with impostor syndrome regarding the main day job.

item.title: Moon Inferno: My Custom React UI Framework is Online! (★´∀｀★)
item.description: Announcing Moon-Inferno, an accessibility-first React UI framework and design system built for retro, Y2K, CRT, cyberpunk, and pixel art web applications.

item.title: Compiling Sanity: When Code is the Only Escape ( ﾟ，_ゝ｀)
item.description: A deeply personal reflection on going through a rough patch, dealing with racing thoughts, and how programming and web development have become the only distraction that keeps my mind anchored.

item.title: Midnight Tides and Temperature Shocks: A Night at the Beach (★´∀｀★)
item.description: A personal reflection on spending a beautiful night at the beach on August 2nd—starry skies, a midnight swim, the biting cold of the sea breeze, and the harsh morning heat.

item.title: Broken Circuits and Unstable Sleep Cycles: The Webmaster's Night Log (￣_￣|||)
item.description: An introspective reflection on chronic insomnia, racing thoughts, and the unstable equilibrium of sleeping too little or sleeping too much in the life of a software developer.

item.title: Exiting the Shell: A Melancholy Journey to Nuremberg (︶︹︶)
item.description: A deeply personal reflection on leaving Italy for the very first time, overcoming travel anxiety, and learning to face social anxiety in Nuremberg with the support of a friend.

item.title: Beyond the Screen: Building a Retro Windows XP Visual Novel with Zero AI (っ•‿•)っ
item.description: A deep dive into Oltre lo Schermo (Beyond the Screen), an upcoming retro visual novel about social isolation (hikikomori), mental health, and 2000s nostalgia, built on Ren'Py with a custom Python/Pillow Windows XP interface and absolutely zero AI content.

item.title: OS-Tans: When the Internet Turned Operating Systems into Anime Mascots (◡‿◡✿)
item.description: A trip back to the early 2000s Futaba Channel to discover OS-tans: the adorable, chaotic personifications of Windows, Linux, and Mac, with a special focus on the elegant and stable 2K-tan.

item.title: No More What Ifs: The Melancholic Jazz of Persona 5 Royal that Smells Like Rain and Calm (旦~)
item.description: An intimate reflection on one of the most hidden and beautiful tracks in Persona 5 Royal. That jazz club in Kichijoji, the rain outside, and the peace of finally stopping the 'what ifs'.

item.title: Bullet Hell meets Action-RPG: Touhou Scarlet Curiosity Review (★´∀｀★)
item.description: My personal review of Ankake Spa's charming 3D action RPG Touhou Scarlet Curiosity on the Nintendo Switch. Beautiful levels, bullet-dodging bosses, and amazing music.

item.title: Anemoia: Nostalgia for a Cyber-Past We Never Lived (´◡`)
item.description: An exploration of anemoia — the longing for a past you've never personally experienced — and why the early 2000s web feels like home to so many of us today.

item.title: Biagio Cyberspace: How I Rebuilt the 2003 Web in 2026
item.description: A nostalgic journey through HTML tables, beveled SCSS styling, and pixel art to rediscover the joy of hand-crafted websites.

item.title: How Welcome to the NHK Changed My Life ｡ﾟ(ﾟ´ω`ﾟ)ﾟ｡
item.description: A deeply personal reflection on how a dark comedy anime about a hikikomori helped me understand my own struggles with anxiety, isolation, and finding a reason to keep going.

item.title: The PS Vita Deserved Better (╥﹏╥)
item.description: A love letter to Sony's forgotten handheld. Why the PlayStation Vita was years ahead of its time, and why I still play mine in 2026.

item.title: Why I Still Love React in 2026 (ﾉ◕ヮ◕)ﾉ*:・ﾟ✧
item.description: After years of framework wars, hot takes, and new shiny tools every week, React is still my favorite library. Here's why it stuck with me.

item.title: Welcome to Biagio Cyberspace ☆ﾟ.*・｡ﾟ
item.description: The grand opening of my personal corner of the web. A small introduction about who I am, what you'll find here, and why I decided to build this site in 2026.
